description: Wait/poll for a Jules session to complete. Automatically tracks progress, emits progress notifications, and returns a unified payload with final state, summary, and PR details upon resolution. Bounded by a wait limit to prevent timeouts.

includeActivities.description: Number of recent activities to include in the output (default: 5)

maxWaitSeconds.description: Maximum time to wait/poll in seconds (default: 60, max: 300)

name: jules_wait_for_session
title: Wait for Jules Session to Complete
